notes.account: The continuation proposes carrying the preceding discussion into excellent schemes using étale tubular neighborhoods. A fine homotopy type would be obtained by a limit over increasingly fine equisingular stratifications with nonsingular strata. It would encode all the indicated sheaves or n-champs, via an inductive limit qualification, and would depend functorially on X in a suitable sense. The author proposes expressing strong cohomological or homotopical finiteness results by saying that ordinary constituent types are essentially finite polyhedra, and even compact manifolds with boundary; the sentence continues after a final comma.
notes.uncertainty_scope: These conditionals and qualifications belong to the author's proposal. They are not proof claims and are separate from the reader's paleographic doubts.
notes.page_date_title_evidence: Author number 36 appears at the top; archive pencil 181 at bottom left. No date, title, greeting, closing, or signature is visible on this sheet. The opening and terminal comma show continuation prose.
notes.paragraph_evidence: One continuous text block, without indentation or a separator establishing a new paragraph; Dans on L14 follows X. on the same baseline.
notes.math_triggered_reading_decisions: No mathematical inference was used to supply a plural s, a missing word, or an abbreviation expansion. In particular the singular élément, cohomologique, homotopique, ordinaire, and fin are kept where the ink has no s. The barred sign is resolved by its curved lower stroke, not by sentence meaning.
notes.proof_status: No proof, independent re-proof, computation, or formal mathematical verification was attempted. check_events is empty; reading the proposed limit construction and finiteness assertions is not a check.
